item.title: Chile: Engie commissions 802MWh BESS, Grenergy finances 1,769MWh
item.description: Energy Storage News — Power group Engie has put an 142MW/802MWh BESS project in Chile into operation, while IPP Grenergy has secured financing for the fifth and final stage of its Oasis de Atacama solar-plus-storage project.

item.title: France defines terms for long-term capacity auction
item.description: PV Magazine — France's energy regulator has proposed the parameters for the country's first long-term capacity auction, covering the winter of 2030-31. The auction will target 82 GW of capacity, including 3 GW eligible for multi-year contracts, as France seeks to safeguard electricity supplies while limiting costs for consumers.

item.title: Eskom kicks off tender for 6 GW of renewables-plus-storage
item.description: PV Magazine — South African utility Eskom has launched a qualification process to select strategic partners for up to 6 GW of renewable energy and storage projects. The portfolio will include at least 2 GW of solar and 1 GW/4 GWh of battery storage, with selected developers joining a five-year co-development and investment framework.

item.title: Study identifies new PID degradation mechanism in medium-voltage PV modules
item.description: PV Magazine — French researchers have found that increasing PV system voltage significantly worsens potential-induced degradation (PID), with encapsulant conductivity playing a key role in module performance. They also identified a new degradation mechanism involving partial discharges and electrical treeing, highlighting additional reliability risks for medium-voltage PV modules.

item.title: Risen releases 23.5%-efficient anti-glare heterojunction solar module
item.description: PV Magazine — Risen Energy has unveiled a new anti-glare heterojunction solar module featuring a dual-layer optical design and a power output of up to 730 W. The bifacial panel achieves a maximum efficiency of 23.5% and has received Class AAA anti-glare certification from TÜV Rheinland.
